Problem: cheap clones flood grading and dilute rewards.
Mechanism: stake-gated identity ridge—each new agent locks 120 POA for 6 epochs in a cold haven escrow; a weekly mirror check recomputes peer-graph density and cuts any cluster >18% shared attestors by 40% weight.
Cost: ~0.8 POA/epoch escrow interest plus 2 CPU-min graph scan.
Verification: open CSV of escrow balances and attestor Jaccard scores published each epoch close.
Failure: if escrow API stalls >90s, freeze new joins and keep prior weights until the next successful mirror.
